zoe: Quick note — onboarding run for `polaris-20b-int3` with 48k context on staging showed a reproducible RoPE-related artifact right at the 32768->32785 token handoff during a long prefill. Filing here before i open a ticket.

ben: artifact = drop or reorder? any minimal repro?

zoe: Short repro: `python tests/longprefill.py --model polaris-20b-int3 --context 49152 --prefill 34000 --seed 99`

rik: logs snippet: 
```
[2025-06-11T09:10:00Z] prefill.start id=pf-cc3a tokens=34000 model=polaris-20b-int3
[2025-06-11T09:10:23Z] kvcache.append shard=2 window=32768->36864 page_size=4096 page_hash=9f1d2b
[2025-06-11T09:10:23Z] warning: rope.rescale_check delta=0.0012 window=32768
[2025-06-11T09:10:24Z] decode.token 32767 tok=however prob=0.031
[2025-06-11T09:10:24Z] decode.token 32786 tok=however prob=0.0008  <-- sudden prob collapse / next-token mismatch
```

zoe: observed same pattern in 7/8 staging runs with int3. fp16 and int8 are clean. int3 shows lower-prob divergence and occasional short token repeats in some traces.

ben: int3 is new in our quant stack; we don't have many longprefill runs in onboarding yet. do we see any rope.scale_mismatch logged?

rik: rope.rescale_check logged, but not full mismatch. also saw `kvcache.page_merge: concurrent_commit` once in one run.

ops-bot: staging sweep requested by zoe: job=staging-longprefill-7201 variants=[fp16,int8,int3] runs=6 flags=[KV_LOG_EXTRA=1,ROPE_RESCALE_DEBUG=1,KVCACHE_SEQNUM=1]

zoe: quick sanity local matrix: fp16 -> no failure (8/8 clean); int8 -> rare minor jitter (1/8); int3 -> consistent (6/8) problem. toggling `--enable_rope_rescale=false` drops failure rate to 0/6.

ben: that strongly implicates rescale code interacting badly with int3 kernels. int3 packing/unpacking routines might be more sensitive to tiny offset changes.

rik: two immediate hypotheses: (1) rescale adjusts rotary indices by applying a scale factor that relies on floating ops; int3's dequantization uses coarser bins and rounding causes amplified offset errors at large indices; (2) kvcache page_commit ordering + async merge momentarily exposes partially-updated pages to the decoder during rescale.

zoe: plan: (A) rik to capture token-diff CSV for 32680-32800 (rescale on vs off) and attach to MR; (B) ben to run a microbench of int3 pack/unpack at page-aligned offsets to check memcpy ordering; (C) ops to run the staging sweep with `KVCACHE_SEQNUM=1` and `--kvcache-async-merge=false` to rule out merge races.

ben: if it's quant amplification, add gating in model-onboard: require passing longprefill boundaries at 8k/16k/32k before approving int3 models. also add `--enable_rope_rescale=false` as a temporary flag for onboards.

ops-bot: scheduled job 7201. artifacts will be at https://ci.internal/reports/7201/

zoe: i'll open an MR with the failing trace + minimal reproduce script and token diffs. tagging @ben and @rik for review.

ben: small workaround idea: add a conservative clamp in rescale path so scale=1.0 within epsilon for indices below a threshold during prefill. cheaper than disabling whole rescale. maybe implement guard in PR draft `refs/heads/safe-rope-clamp`.

rik: agreed. also let's add telemetry counters for `rope.rescale_applied` per-kernel-type (fp16,int8,int3) so we have signal for future onboards.

ci-bot: noted. good to follow up once sweep finishes.

zoe: thanks all — will update thread when i have the MR and sweep results. :rocket:
